title: Blinding in Euclid DR1
author: Cail Daley
description: Opening slides for the CMBX SWG blinding session: how the Euclid groups blind DR1, what the blindspot tool does, how large a blind should be, and how CMBX can check its data vectors against other groups' while each is blinded separately.
